segments.caption: A man drives a white car along a tree-lined road, with shots alternating between his focused expression at the wheel and the scenic, leaf-strewn street outside.

A white car drives along a tree-lined road, and the camera zooms in on one of its wheels, setting the stage for a tutorial on how to use a tyre repair kit, as indicated by the "Which?" logo and title card.

The video begins with a close-up of a white car's wheel, then transitions to the interior where a finger presses the blue power button to start the engine. The final frame shows the car's dashboard with the hazard light and passenger airbag indicators illuminated, signaling the vehicle is now running.

A presenter inspects a white car, beginning with a close-up of the dashboard showing the passenger airbag warning light illuminated, then moving to the exterior where he kneels to examine the front wheel, suggesting he is diagnosing a potential issue with the vehicle.

A man inspects his white Toyota, first checking the rear wheel, then moving to the back of the car to adjust the license plate, and finally opening the trunk to look inside, all while crouching on a leaf-strewn pavement.
A man retrieves a portable air compressor and sealant from his car’s trunk, preparing to fix a flat tire on the vehicle’s rear wheel.
A person is fixing a flat tire on a white car by applying sealant from a bottle into the valve stem, with the car parked on a leaf-strewn cobblestone street.

A man crouches beside a white car on a leaf-strewn sidewalk, using a portable air compressor to inflate a tire. He connects the hose to the valve stem and operates the device, demonstrating the process of maintaining proper tire pressure.

A man is shown charging his electric vehicle by plugging a charging cable into the car’s charging port, then proceeds to plug the other end into a 12V socket inside the car, likely to power a device or charge a smaller battery.
A person plugs a device into a car's 12V socket to power a portable tire inflator, which they then use to inflate a flat tire on the ground.

A close-up, low-angle shot follows the rear wheel of a light-colored car as it slowly rolls forward over a cobblestone sidewalk scattered with fallen autumn leaves. The camera tracks the tire’s movement, capturing the details of the alloy rim and tread as it presses down on the stones, conveying a quiet, deliberate motion through an urban, seasonal setting.

A car is shown in motion, beginning with a close-up of its tire rolling over fallen autumn leaves on a cobblestone curb, then pulling away down a quiet residential street lined with modern buildings and trees, before the view is briefly obscured by a dark pole as the vehicle continues driving down the road.
A man is driving a white car along a leaf-strewn, tree-lined road, speaking as he navigates the scenic route.
A man drives a white car along a tree-lined, leaf-strewn road, speaking to the camera as he navigates the scenic route.

A driver is seen navigating a tree-lined road, followed by a transition to a promotional segment from the consumer magazine "Which?" advertising a one-month trial for just £1, which includes guides on finding the best buy tyres, saving money on tyres, and recommended breakdown companies.

This static promotional graphic from Which? invites viewers to sign up for a one-month trial for just £1. The central message is reinforced by three key offerings: finding the 'Best Buy tyres', learning 'How to save money on tyres', and accessing a list of 'Recommended breakdown companies'. The image remains unchanged across the frames, serving as a consistent call-to-action.
